family_title_en: Spell the long i word: silent e, ie, y

stages.ix_title: Spell the long i word: silent e, ie, y

prompt.en: Which long i spelling is right?

stages.choice_rule: Make four unique lowercase whole-word choices that attempt one long i word. Exactly one is the correct spelling with silent e, ie, or final y. The other three misspell that same word. Set answer_index to the correct choice. The stem is a kid-world clue of at most ten words and must not contain the correct spelling. Use only roots.txt words, allowed_extra_words, and <NAME> in the stem. Never write a real name. Cover silent e, ie, and final y, and include two-syllable words such as inside, decide, and bedtime. Do not make igh, ind, or ild the correct spelling.

gold_items.stem: Hot apple food with a crust.
You do this when you are sad.
Your face does this when you are happy.
Dad will put this on the neck.
The sun and the moon are in this.
<NAME> can put a word on paper at school.
A fun toy that can fly on a string.

roots: Give four spellings of the same long i word, and exactly one spelling is correct.
Wrong spellings belong in the choices. Do not hide a misspelling inside the stem.
Tier 1 wrong spellings change the vowel or add odd letters so they do not look like the real word.
Tier 2 wrong spellings drop the silent e or swap ie, final y, and silent e.
Tier 3 wrong spellings are one letter off, a short-i twin such as kit, or a homophone such as rite or wright.
Do not use igh, ind, or ild as the correct choice. Those are not this skill.
Choices are whole words. Never use IPA, a single phoneme, or a held sound.

tier_rules.1: Familiar kid words in stems of about seven words or fewer. Wrong spellings change the vowel or add odd letters and are not real words.
tier_rules.2: Grade-level words in stems of about seven to nine words. Wrong spellings drop silent e or swap ie, y, and silent e.
tier_rules.3: Near misses and homophones, including listed errors such as kyte and rite. Stems run about eight to ten words. Two-syllable targets such as inside and decide belong here too.

silent_e.en: A silent e at the end makes i say its name.
silent_e.ko: 끝의 묵음 e가 i를 이름대로 읽게 해요.

ie_long_i.en: The letters ie together can say long i.
ie_long_i.ko: ie가 나란히 있으면 긴 i 소리가 나요.

y_long_i.en: At the end of a short word, y can say long i.
y_long_i.ko: 짧은 단어 끝의 y는 긴 i 소리가 나요.

write_spell.en: Write means to put a word on paper. It ends with silent e.
write_spell.ko: write는 종이에 단어를 쓴다는 뜻이에요. 끝에 묵음 e가 있어요.
